//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Shadow Mounts -> Config

Enable Shadow Mounts.//: Whether Shadow Mounts is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

darkenHorseTexture.//: Whether the horse's texture should be darkened when equiped with a shadow saddle.

showShadowHorseParticles.//: Whether the particles should be shown for shadow mounts.

onlyShowParticlesWhenRiding.//: If enabled, shadow mount particles are only shown when a player is riding them.
